answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 24677 Country: Bangladesh Title: Is it permisible to perform salah behind an imam who is a blind person? If he is well educated Question: Is it permisible to perform salah behind an imam who is a blind person? If he is well educated. Answer ID: 24677 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1558/1227/B=1431) Yes, it is lawful. Whenever the holy Prophet Muhammad (صلى الله عليه وسلم) had to go for Jihad, journey etc he appointed Hadhrat Abdullah ibn Um Maktoom or Hadhrat U’tban ibn Malik (رضى الله عنهما) for imamah (leading salah) in his place and these used to do imamah in Masjid-e-Nabwi while they were blind. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
